parties.petitioner: The Animal Welfare Board Of India & ORS

summary: Constitutional validity of State amendments legitimizing bull sports challenged; Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Karnataka amendments upheld; cultural heritage rights under Article 29; animal welfare regulations under Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 reconciled with tradition; Presidential assent under Article 254(2) valid; cultural preservation vs animal cruelty balance assessed through legislative competence framework; repugnancy test applied; restrictions on bull sports lifted subject to welfare safeguards.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 s.3, s.11(1)(a), s.11(1)(m)
Constitution of India Art.14, Art.21, Art.254(1), Art.254(2), Art.29, Art.48, Art.51-A(g), Art.51-A(h)
A. Nagaraja vs Union of India (2014) 7 SCC 547
final_judgment: State amendment acts upheld; restrictions on Jallikattu, Bullock Cart Race, Kambala lifted; challenge to Presidential assent dismissed; notification GSR 13(E) validated with cultural exception; writ petitions dismissed except in part for rule compliance.
